headline: Fallout 3: The Capital Wasteland
title: Fallout 3 Facts | Vault 101 Story | Classic Games
video_script: Fallout three is a two thousand eight action role playing game from Bethesda Game Studios, released on Windows, PlayStation three and Xbox 360. It is set in the Washington D C area, two hundred years after a devastating nuclear war. You start in Vault one oh one and leave it to search for your missing father. Favourite Fallout game? Comment below!
